new_today_news.headline: Cutting Through Sewer Line FOG
new_today_news.summary: Johnson County Wastewater's FOG prevention program combines regular inspection and enforcement at commercial establishments with residential educational outreach to prevent collection system maintenance problems and sanitary sewer overflows.

new_today_news.headline: What's in the Cards for Darling Ingredients in Q3 Earnings Release?
new_today_news.summary: Darling Ingredients is expected to report Q3 2026 earnings on October 29 with revenue guidance of $1.8 billion (14% increase YoY). Management expects strong core-business fundamentals and favorable momentum entering Q4.

new_today_news.headline: Clean Harbors (CLH) Projected to Release Quarterly Earnings on Wednesday
new_today_news.summary: Clean Harbors will likely be posting its Q3 2026 results before the market opens on Wednesday, October 28th, with analysts expecting earnings of $3.26 per share and revenue of $1.73 billion.

new_today_news.headline: More than 7,500 U.S. restaurant locations closed in six months
new_today_news.summary: More than 7,500 U.S. restaurant locations closed in the first half of 2026 due to rising costs and declining sales. CBS News reported the closures were nationwide rather than isolated to specific regions or chains.

recent_news.headline: Darling Ingredients Reaffirms FY26 Outlook Despite DGD Margin Compression
recent_news.summary: Darling Ingredients maintained its FY26 adjusted EBITDA guidance of $2.2-$2.3 billion despite notable margin pressure in its Diamond Green Diesel joint venture, with unit economics facing 18% compression to $1.30 per gallon.

recent_news.headline: Mashed: The Most Unexpected Chain Restaurant Closures To Happen In 2026
recent_news.summary: O'Charley's permanently closed all remaining 49 locations in 2026. Papa John's initiated a multi-year plan to close up to 300 locations across 17 states. Starbucks announced sudden closures of 250 cafes with one week's notice.

recent_news.headline: Hooters keeps closing restaurants as bankruptcy comeback sputters
recent_news.summary: Hooters has closed approximately 56 restaurant locations so far in 2026. The closures reflect broader industry challenges despite the chain's attempted bankruptcy comeback.

recent_news.headline: Pittsburgh restaurant openings & closings: October guide
recent_news.summary: Pittsburgh area restaurant activity report for October 2026 showing new openings including a Mediterranean restaurant on Butler Street in Lawrenceville and a SouthSide Works bakery.

recent_news.headline: GFL Environmental (GFL) Projected to Announce Quarterly Earnings on Wednesday
recent_news.summary: GFL Environmental will be releasing its Q3 2026 earnings after the market closes on Wednesday, October 28, with analysts expecting earnings of $0.1878 per share and revenue of $1.49 billion.

recent_news.headline: Committee approves raising hauling and tipping fees after nearby facility closure
recent_news.summary: Warren County's committee approved raising tipping fees from $68 to $99.00 per ton and hauling rates from $3.14 to $3.45 per mile after a nearby disposal facility closure increased hauling distances.

recent_news.headline: City proposes housekeeping changes to sewer ordinance on FOG, impact fees and meters
recent_news.summary: Saco City proposes minor code amendments to its sewer ordinance to clarify fat/soil/grease device timelines, standardize impact fees, and improve transparency and consistency for businesses and staff.

backfill_news.headline: Top Waste-to-Energy Companies in 2026
backfill_news.summary: Guide covering leading waste-to-energy operators and technology providers, including LanzaTech's gas-fermentation platform for waste-to-fuel conversion and Enerkem's gasification-based process for converting waste to fuels.
